```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, include = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(TZ = "America/New_York")
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(svglite)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)

link_color <- "#0047AB"
```

```{r data-processing}
project_root <- tryCatch(here::here(), error = function(e) getwd())
csv_path <- file.path(project_root, "GMRI_Engagement_Opportunities.csv")

if (!file.exists(csv_path)) stop("CSV file not found at expected location: ", csv_path)

items <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    Deadline = as.Date(Deadline),
    Posted   = as.Date(Posted),
    IsNew    = replace_na(IsNew, FALSE)
  ) |>
  filter(is.na(Deadline) | Deadline >= Sys.Date())

new_indices <- which(items$IsNew)
has_new     <- length(new_indices) > 0
break_index <- if (has_new) max(new_indices) + 1 else 1

items_out <- items |>
  mutate(
    Title      = paste0("<a href='", AdditionalInfoURL, "' style='color:", link_color, ";'>", Title, "</a>"),
    Deadline   = if_else(is.na(Deadline), "—", format(Deadline, "%b %d, %Y")),
    Posted     = if_else(is.na(Posted),   "—", format(Posted,   "%b %d, %Y")),
    Categories = replace_na(Categories, ""),
    New        = if_else(IsNew, "<span style='color:#ea4f12;font-size:1.2em;'>&#x25CF;</span>", "")
  ) |>
  select(Agency, Title, Categories, New, Deadline, Posted)

break_row <- tibble(Agency = "&nbsp;", Title = "&nbsp;", Categories = "&nbsp;",
                    New = "&nbsp;", Deadline = "&nbsp;", Posted = "&nbsp;")

if (!has_new) {
  no_new_row <- tibble(
    Agency = "", Categories = "", New = "", Deadline = "", Posted = "",
    Title  = "<strong>&#128587; No new engagement opportunities since the last update.</strong>"
  )
  items_out <- bind_rows(no_new_row, break_row, items_out)
} else {
  items_out <- bind_rows(
    items_out[1:(break_index - 1), ],
    break_row,
    items_out[break_index:nrow(items_out), ]
  )
}
```

```{r date-heading, include=TRUE, results="asis"}
cat("# Engagement Opportunities —", format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y"), "\n\n")
cat("*Requests for Information, Notices of Intent, FACA/advisory-committee nomination calls, ",
    "review-panel solicitations, Sources Sought/Special Notices, and public meetings/workshops ",
    "— things to notice and respond to, not funding to apply for.*\n\n")
```

```{r table-output, include=TRUE, results="asis"}
fmt        <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to")
tbl_format <- ifelse(fmt == "html", "html", "latex")

kable(items_out, format = tbl_format, escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = if (tbl_format == "html") "striped" else NULL,
    latex_options     = if (tbl_format == "latex") c("striped", "hold_position") else NULL,
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) |>
  row_spec(break_index, background = "#686868")
```
